Bill.BriefDescription: Adding the superintendent of public instruction to the higher education coordinating board.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to higher education coordinating board membership;amending RCW 28B.80.400; and reenacting and amending RCW 28B.80.390.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 28B.80.390 and 2002 c 348 s 1 and 2002 c 129 s 1 areeach reenacted and amended to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The board shall consist of ((ten)) eleven members((, one of whomshall be a student, who are)) as follows: Nine shall be representativeof the public, including women and the racial minority community; oneshall be a student; and one shall be the superintendent of publicinstruction, serving ex officio. Except for the superintendent ofpublic instruction, all members shall be appointed at large by thegovernor and approved by the senate. Following the term of the chairserving on June 13, 2002, the board shall select from its membership achair and a vicechair who shall each serve a oneyear term. The chairand vicechair may serve more than one term if selected to do so by themembership.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 28B.80.400 and 2002 c 129 s 2 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The members of the board, except the chair ((and)), the studentmember, and the superintendent of public instruction, shall serve forterms of four years, the terms expiring on June 30th of the fourth yearof the term except that in the case of initial members, two shall beappointed to twoyear terms, three shall be appointed to threeyearterms, and three shall be appointed to fouryear terms. The studentmember shall hold his or her office for a term of one year from thefirst day of July. The term of the superintendent of publicinstruction shall be concurrent with the term of office.
